slots.name: daily recoupment fee
slots.sentence: Connecticut attempted to recoup pay-to-stay fees at a rate of $249 a day, or $90,885 a year—the highest rate in the country in 2022.

slots.name: Connecticut prison share
slots.sentence: Pay-to-stay fees create an additional barrier for those attempting to reenter society following a prison sentence and have been found to disproportionately affect Black and Latino residents, who represent one third of the general population and approximately 71% of the prison population in Connecticut.

slots.name: annual recoupment fee

slots.name: repeal date
slots.sentence: when Connecticut became one of only a few states to pass a partial repeal of state-level pay-to-stay recoupment statutes in May 2022
